title: Delhi Traffic Police enforcement figures, 2011 to 2018, as printed in the annual reports
scope: Delhi citywide; not split by district. Counts, not rates.

measures.drink_driving_prosecutions: persons prosecuted: the DRUNKEN DRIVING row of the offence-wise table of on-the-spot challans (Table 9.3). The 2019 to 2022 series is persons caught and prosecuted, the same wording; the tables of those later reports were not compared line by line, so the join at 2018 to 2019 is a compare-with-caution one.
measures.overspeed_challans_on_the_spot: challans issued on the spot for OVER SPEED (Table 9.3). A different measure from the over-speeding notices from OSVD and tripod cameras counted from 2019 (2.5 million in 2019): the two are never joined.
measures.hit_and_run_fatal_crashes: fatal crashes in which the vehicle was not stopped, from the chapter 8 text of each report

sources.file: Chapter 9 (Challan and prosecution statistics), Road Accidents in Delhi 2015

how_read: Table 9.3 was read from the page rendered at 300 dpi. The 2014 and 2015 columns appear in both the 2015 and the 2018 report and agree for both measures; the 2015 to 2018 drink-driving figures and the 2017 and 2018 over-speed figures are also stated in the reports' chapter 8 text. 2011 to 2013 appear in one report only. Reports for 2011 to 2014 are not on the Traffic Police site now, so no hit-and-run count exists here for 2011 to 2014 (the 2014 share is printed in the 2015 report).
